第510章全院尽听冷千双安排（二合一章）
初春，暖阳和煦，山风清冽，青云山脉云雾缭绕，处处生机盎然。（今天差了一章，凌晨两点之前会在这一章末尾补齐，宝宝们明天早上再看吧！）
青云峰主殿内。
空旷的大厅里坐着一圈修士，包括道院三殿的长老及各自的首席执事、七司的司长、副司长……
以及，六峰的六位峰主。
是的，虞既白被冷千双喊回来开会了，连带着把萧杙这个亲传弟子也揪回来了——这俩人自然选择乖乖听话，大不了开完会再回岱舆山。
此刻，萧杙站在冷千双的座位后，垂眸静默，绝不多言。
六位峰主坐在主座下首，左右各三，再往后就是长老们和司长副司长们的位置。
亲传弟子及首席执事则是站在自己师父或领头上司的椅子后面。
每个人的座位之间都隔了约莫有一米多，只有墨微尘和秦优的位置特殊。
两人的弟子一个在闭关一个被关在九阙没回来，两个孤寡老人就这样凑在一起嘀嘀咕咕，把道院里的人都蛐蛐了个遍。
哦对，孤寡老人还有虞既白，但虞既白话少，心里还担心着远在岱舆山的温郗，实在没什么话想说，墨微尘也就不打扰他。
尤其是，道院里的人都知道院长的性子，每次开会都是几个时辰起步，所以秦优甚至带了一个大葫芦，葫芦里装满了各种口味的鲜瓜子。
殿内很是安静，只有诸位在座者时不时端起茶杯的品茶声与小声交谈，其中偶尔夹杂着茶碗茶盖相碰的清脆声响和秦优墨微尘两人“咔咔咔”的嗑瓜子声。
这一次，青云道院内管事的各位掌权人来的格外齐全。
一群在启明洲内有着极高威望的高阶修士，此刻聚在这座大殿内，眉宇间都或多或少了带了一点无奈或焦躁。
因为，他们已经在此等了一个时辰了。
脾气好的，比如虞既白，只是无奈；脾气暴躁的，比如冷千双，已经想抬手把青云殿给轰了。
“咚！”冷千双将手里的茶杯重重砸在桌上，脸上的火气已是藏不住。
所有人闻声看来，有的眼底带着看热闹的期待，比如墨微尘、秦优等；有的则是有些忐忑生怕被殃及，比如公孙陵、李知渊等；有的甚至想跟团一起发火，比如赵千千。

言攸宁在心中叹了口气，苦着脸连忙上前递上一颗泻火清心的丹药——短短一个时辰，这种事她已经做了七八次了，已是格外娴熟。
“不吃了！不吃了！”冷千双一把拂开言攸宁的手，“还吃什么吃，再吃多少都没用，我已经要窝火死了，这个云想——”
话音还未落，殿内主座的位置上突然涌起一股空间波动。
空中灵光乍现，星星点点，闪着淡淡的粉色光晕，状似桃花。那些花瓣朝着主座的方向徐徐飘去，主座之上渐渐凝出一道粉色身影。
女修落座时不疾不徐，广袖轻拂，殿中自有阵阵风起。那风裹着她身上独有的桃花香，自主座之上铺散开来，顷刻间席卷整座大殿。
“咚、咚、咚……”
殿内诸位放下茶杯，瓷器被搁置在桌面上，接连发出了沉闷的声响。他们微微侧首，都看向主座上的云想衣。
冷千双翻了个白眼，安静了下来。
云想衣现身后端坐了刚不到一瞬，便身子一歪倚在了主座的把手上。殿内灵火洒下，她身上的粉色衣袍泛着温润光泽。

Chapter 510: The whole hospital listens to Leng Qianshuang’s arrangements (two chapters in one chapter)
In early spring, the sun is warm, the mountain breeze is crisp, the Qingyun Mountains are shrouded in clouds and mist, and everything is full of life. (There is a chapter missing today. It will be completed at the end of this chapter before two o'clock in the morning. Children, please read it again tomorrow morning!)
Inside the main hall of Qingyun Peak.
There was a circle of monks sitting in the empty hall, including the elders of the three halls of the Taoist temple and their respective chief deacons, the director and deputy director of the seventh department...
And, the six peak masters of the six peaks.
Yes, Yu Jibai was called back for a meeting by Leng Qianshuang, and he also brought back Xiao Yao, his direct disciple. Naturally, these two people chose to be obedient, and at worst they would return to Daiyu Mountain after the meeting.
At this moment, Xiao Zhu stood behind Leng Qianshuang's seat, eyes lowered and silent, never saying anything.
The six peak masters sat at the head of the main seat, three on each side, and behind them were the elders and the directors and deputy directors.
Disciples and chief deacons stand behind the chair of their master or leader.
Everyone's seats are about one meter apart. Only Mo Weichen and Qin You have special positions.
One of their disciples was in seclusion and the other was locked up in Jiuque and had not returned. The two lonely old men just gathered together and murmured, eating crickets all over the Taoist temple.
Oh, yes, there is the lonely old man and Yu Jibai, but Yu Jibai talks little and is still worried about Wen Xi who is far away in Daiyu Mountain. He really has nothing to say, so Mo Weichen doesn't bother him.
In particular, everyone in the Taoist Temple knew the dean's temperament. Every meeting would start at several hours, so Qin You even brought a big gourd filled with fresh melon seeds of various flavors.
The hall was very quiet, except for the sounds of teacups and whispers from those present holding teacups from time to time. Occasionally, there was the crisp sound of tea bowls and tea lids clinking together, and the sound of Qin You and Mo Mochen cracking melon seeds.
This time, all the powerful people in charge of the Qingyun Taoist Temple came especially well.
A group of high-level monks with extremely high prestige in Qiming Continent are gathered in this hall at this moment, with more or less helplessness or anxiety on their brows.
Because they have been waiting here for an hour.
Those with a good temper, such as Yu Jibai, are helpless; those with a bad temper, such as Leng Qianshuang, already want to blast Qingyun Palace with their hands.
"Boom!" Leng Qianshuang slammed the tea cup in her hand on the table, the anger on her face could no longer be hidden.
When everyone heard the sound, some looked forward to watching the fun, such as Mo Weichen, Qin You, etc.; others were a little nervous for fear of being affected, such as Gongsun Ling, Li Zhiyuan, etc.; some even wanted to get angry with the group, such as Zhao Qianqian.
Yan Youning sighed in his heart, and with a grimace, he quickly stepped forward and handed over a pill that purified the fire and purified the heart. In just one hour, she had done this seven or eight times, and she was extremely skilled at it.
"Don't eat! Don't eat!" Leng Qianshuang brushed Yan Youning's hand away, "Eat whatever you want, no matter how much you eat, it's useless. I'm already going to die of anger. This Yun Xiang-"
Before he finished speaking, a spatial fluctuation suddenly surged from the main seat in the hall.
A sudden flash of inspiration appeared in the sky, with stars dotted with a faint pink halo, resembling peach blossoms. The petals slowly floated towards the main seat, and a pink figure gradually formed on the main seat.
The female cultivator sat down calmly, her broad sleeves flicking, and there was a gust of wind blowing in the hall. The wind wrapped the unique peach blossom fragrance on her body, spread over the main seat, and swept the entire hall in an instant.
"Dong, dong, dong..."
Everyone in the hall put down their teacups, and the porcelain was placed on the table, making dull sounds one after another. They tilted their heads slightly and looked at Yun Xiangyi on the main seat.
Leng Qianshuang rolled her eyes and became quiet.
Yun Xiangyi appeared and sat upright for less than a moment before leaning on the handle of the main seat.
